title: Only Optimizer
description: No bloated utilities. No fluff. Just extreme optimization. Welcome to Only Optimizer.
body:
# Only Optimizer

> **NO** bloated utilities. **NO** fluff. **JUST** extreme optimization.

A performance-focused modpack with a single goal: make Minecraft run as fast as possible. Every mod included earns its place — nothing extra, nothing unnecessary.

Includes **Complementary Unbound r5.8 + Euphoria Patches** out of the box, so you get stunning visuals without sacrificing performance.

---

## ✦ Featured Mods

| Category | Mods |
|---|---|
| **Rendering** | Sodium, Iris, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, More Culling |
| **World & Chunks** | Lithium, C2ME, Distant Horizons, ScalableLux, Alternate Current |
| **Memory** | FerriteCore, ModernFix, BadOptimizations |
| **Network** | Krypton, Packet Fixer, XL Packets, Server Pinger Fixer |
| **Upscaling** | Super Resolution (FSR / DLSS / XeSS) |
| **QoL** | Dynamic FPS, Mod Menu, Crash Assistant |

---

## ✦ Included Shader

**Complementary Unbound r5.8 + Euphoria Patches 1.9.0** is bundled and pre-configured, ready to use from the first launch.

---

## ✦ Requirements

- **Loader:** Fabric 0.19.2
- **Minecraft:** 26.1.2
- **RAM:** 4GB minimum, 6GB+ recommended
- A **GPU** that supports OpenGL 4.6 is required for the shader.
